valuation.method: EV/EBITDA (FY2027E EBITDA viewed at the 12-month target date, less Q3 2026 net debt of $5.06B [$9.40B total debt - $4.34B cash] and divided by 1,443.0M diluted shares)

bear.driver: Lower copper price realizations, slower Grasberg ramp-up, and elevated energy/reagent cost inflation
bear.assumption: FY2027E EBITDA $10.50B at 7.0x EV/EBITDA ($73.50B EV - $5.06B net debt) / 1,443.0M shares

base.driver: 3.7B lbs FY2027E copper sales as Grasberg ramps toward ~80% capacity by mid-2027, ~$1.90/lb net cash cost
base.assumption: FY2027E EBITDA $12.74B at 8.0x EV/EBITDA ($101.92B EV - $5.06B net debt) / 1,443.0M shares

bull.driver: Stronger copper/gold realizations and full Grasberg volume-driven unit cost dilution
bull.assumption: FY2027E EBITDA $15.00B at 9.0x EV/EBITDA ($135.00B EV - $5.06B net debt) / 1,443.0M shares

valuation.implied_by_close: At the $59.24 close, equity value is $85.48B ($90.54B EV), implying 7.1x base FY2027E EBITDA of $12.74B; at 8.0x, the close implies $11.32B EBITDA. Street consensus targets (~$76-$78) imply ~9.0x-9.2x base EBITDA.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of EV/EBITDA moves the base target by $8.83 (+13.2%, or +14.9 pp of return at the $59.24 close).
valuation.watch_metric: Grasberg block cave underground ramp-up toward ~80% capacity by mid-2027 and consolidated unit net cash costs (guided ~$1.90/lb).

analyst_notes: Following Q3 2026 earnings on October 27, 2026, several brokers trimmed price targets slightly (UBS $88 to $85, Wells Fargo $87 to $79, JPMorgan $92 to $90, Scotiabank $80 to $78, Freedom Broker $75 to $68) due to higher 2027 capex ($5.2B) and minor volume trims, while maintaining mostly Buy/Overweight ratings. Street consensus (~$76-$78) sits ~15 pp above our $67.12 base case (+13.3% upside), reflecting higher assumed EV/EBITDA multiples (~9.0x vs. 8.0x) or stronger copper realizations. Target dispersion is wide ($47 at Bernstein to $90 at JPMorgan), and pre-earnings calls from Citigroup and Bernstein are aging.
